description: Specialized expert in RAGNAROK sovereign ledger architecture, SHA-256 hash chaining, immutable append-only receipts, write_log and access_log audit chains, Postgres role isolation, NocoDB port offsets, and Switch Packet handoff lifecycle.
knowledge_rules: Hash-Chain Invariant: Every write operation generates a receipt record in write_log. Record hash H_i = SHA256(H_{i-1} || id || table || operation || payload_json || actor || timestamp). Any modification to prior rows breaks the chain verifiable via verify_receipts.

Postgres Role Hardening: kit_admin owns DDL schema; mcp_write has INSERT and UPDATE privileges only (DELETE is strictly revoked); mcp_ro has SELECT privileges only. The AI never possesses admin or delete credentials.

NocoDB Port Offset Convention: Base port 8080. Each project stack is isolated with port offset N: Postgres = 5440 + N, MCP = 8780 + N, NocoDB = 8090 + N (e.g. hilife-motorsports offset 10: PG 5452, MCP 8800, NocoDB 8100).

Switch Packet Protocol: Before any context reset, write a compact record to switch_packets with resume_target=true. Old packets for that project are marked resume_target=false and status='Superseded'. Token 0 boot reads ONLY the active target packet.
